changes: Canonical source/managed identities exclude named JVM crash, replay, heap-dump and stackdump artifacts.
Managed generated Evidence is excluded even if an IDE/Tooling API temporarily resolves its relative path beneath a module.
The invariant test covers both identity scopes and nested generated Evidence.
ideMitigation: Automatic Java synchronization remains enabled; only the Gradle synchronization backend changes from build server to Buildship on reload so root settings are honored once rather than imported per nested module.
